annotations.title: Advertising market search — segments, forecasts, shares

description: Advertising market search — segments, forecasts, shares. Filtered search over the Ni Biashara advertising shelf's market records: advertising segment sizes, forecast growth rates and revenue shares as published by PwC (Global Entertainment & Media Outlook 2025–2029) and the IAB (Internet Advertising Revenue Report FY2024). Filter by text, segment, channel, scope or a CAGR floor. Every record carries its publisher, report and source URL. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

channel.description: one of all | advertising-total | search | display | video | social | retail-media | audio | connected-tv | games | cinema | connectivity (optional)

limit.description: max records to return (optional, default 25, max 60)

min_cagr.description: only records whose published 2024–2029 CAGR is at least this percent (optional)

q.description: free text over segment, metric, scope and notes (optional)

scope.description: one of global | US | China | India (optional)

segment.description: segment name text, e.g. Retail advertising (optional)
